name: police-and-control-audit-specs
description: Takes a Police & Control business request all the way from intake to an adjudicated finding. First half: intake, Snowflake data-existence check, ERP discovery via Ask the Code, feedback loop, UI mockup, finalised spec, DNA/Jira handoff. Second half (new in 0.4.0): RUNNING the audit — a pre-flight that catches the measurement errors that actually cost rework, six reusable SQL patterns with their guards, a six-value verdict model where VOID and BLOCKED are not passes, and a catalogue of fourteen worked failures with the real before/after numbers. Carries the defects that have cost real rework on both sides.
